required_adapter_behavior: Load fixtures/manifest.json from the pinned PR #237 kit commit; do not copy fixtures.
For POS-CANONICAL-FLOW-001, negotiate version 1.0 and emit messages matching schema.json definitions.
Produce byte-identical RFC 8785 unsigned payload and exact five-field protected header before Ed25519 signing.
Issue lease_id with contract_revision, max_uses=1, identical binding, and TTL no greater than 60 seconds.
Persist canonical quota, UsageEvent, OperationReceipt, credential lease, and business-effect claims with the stated ownership.
Reject every manifest negative case with its exact expected_code before a business effect.
Treat customer-managed OSS non-applicability as optional capability metadata only.

result_contract.positive: all canonical messages emitted and reference-validated

result_contract.non_applicable: mandatory capability waiver count remains zero
